claim_text: Housing vouchers sit unused at some rural Washington agencies.

sources.source_title: Cascade PBS — Housing vouchers sit unused at some rural Washington agencies
sources.relevant_chunk: Housing officials who spoke with Crosscut said they lack the staffing to shepherd clients with high rental barriers through a tight market with few available units and even fewer willing landlords. Larger agencies in Tacoma and Renton report that sky-high rents have outpaced legal limits for what vouchers will pay. And in rural communities with patchy social service networks, housing authorities said partner organizations tasked with feeding clients into the program failed to deliver referrals or lost track of clients.

reasoning: This source highlights a high-profile issue of unused vouchers in rural areas due to various systemic barriers, illustrating the urgency and scale of the problem.
